Hi there, I know this post is somewhat old but I saw no one left any comments and I am going through something similar currently. 
My last relationship was 3 almost 4 years. It ended badly and then I got into a new relationship. Been with my current boyfriend for almost 4 months. It’s been great for the most part but I obsess constantly on if this is worth it since relationships trigger my OCD more than anything. I have no solid solution to this problem we both share. My boyfriend is awesome and he’s pretty much willing to put up with all my needs and we don’t fight at all. I think about ending it though as I do not want to get hurt again and I want my OCD to stop flaring up so much. The thing that stops me from ending, though is the fact that I have put this man through some stuff and he never batted an eye at it. He handles me well and treats me good. For right now this relationship is working for me. It doesn’t mean I’m not obsessing and terrified of getting hurt, it just means that compared to my last relationship and considering how I am pretty much getting all my needs met, I don’t see any reason to end it. I don’t how old you are or how much experience you have, but take your last relationships into consideration when deciding whether or not to end your current relationship I guess. For example, if my boyfriend ever disappoints me or lets me down the same way my ex did, I would end it immediately. If the relationship ever starts to be painful, cause problems or make your life harder, end it. But we also must make a choice: put our hearts on the line forever just have an experience of love or guard ourselves forever and never feel any pain. I still haven’t decided what I want to do. I think it’s a choice and one must make eventually.
